coaching.headline: A one-tower-to-eight loss built on fights taken without five bodies, then Orb Prime falling at 25.6 with four of us dead from the fight at 24.4.
coaching.team: We lost this by fighting without five bodies. First blood went to Serath on Greystone at 2.2, and the early game still held: the river fight at 7.7 went 3-2 and we took Mini Prime at 10. From 12 on, every fight we lost before the last one was taken with teammates alive and no kill or death credited to them. Boris and Iggy & Scorch died 0-2 to Dekker and Serath at 12, and Fangtooth fell at 12.6. At 16.9 Maco, Boris and Kira went 0-3 into Dekker and Riktor with Greystone and Iggy & Scorch both alive and neither credited with a kill or death in it; the outer tower and a second Fangtooth followed. We won the fight at 22.2, 3-1, and they answered by taking Fangtooth across the map. The fight at our outer tower at 24.4, lost 1-4 with Greystone alive and ahead in lane and no kill or death credited to him, left Kira, Maco, Boris and Iggy & Scorch dead, and Orb Prime fell at 25.6 with four of us down. The 5v5 at 26.3, lost 1-5, ended it. They out-warded us 39 to 26. Next game: no fight until all five are standing in it.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Three lost fights became three structures. The fight at 16.9, lost 0-3 with two of us alive and uncredited in it, gave up the outer tower and a Fangtooth. The fight at 24.4, lost 1-4 with four of us dying, gave up Orb Prime at 25.6. The 5v5 at 26.3, lost 1-5, gave up the base.
coaching.whatWorked: Kira's late window: four kills in under two minutes on Dekker, Riktor, Serath and Aurora, and the fight at 22.2 won 3-1 off the back of it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco healed but was in few of the kills: 1 kill and 5 assists on 19 team kills, 16,123 healing, 16,119 damage mitigated. The solo death to Riktor at 10 was the one free kill; the other three came inside fights the team lost. 8 wards to Riktor's 16.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Kira won the late fight. Four kills in under two minutes made the fight at 22.2 a 3-1 win. The fight at 18.5 went 4v5 with Greystone dead and Kira alive and ahead in lane with no kill or death credited in it; a shove-and-rotate there changes the count. Three items by minute 27, none from the core, and four deaths.
perPlayer.6317c922-6a5c-4287-a2a3-24a24aa25bfa: Greystone was caught alone three times. First blood to Serath at 2.2, then solo deaths to Aurora and Serath inside two minutes before minute 20. Alive and ahead in lane with no kill or death credited in the fight at 16.9, lost 0-3, or the one at 24.4, lost 1-4; a shove-and-rotate there changes the count. The lane was fine: three kills on Aurora, the only magic resist.
perPlayer.dd5a8477-4c5d-4f67-a8af-66eea1569e4f: Boris fought every fight and lost the map. 8 kills, 9 deaths, most on the roster, 1 ward placed. Caught alone by Serath at 20.3 with the outer tower falling at 21.7. Two earlier deaths each sat a minute before a Fangtooth. Their side put 55,064 damage into structures to our 7,352, and Boris's 5,943 was most of ours: they took structures while Boris took fights.
perPlayer.495fb001-0cda-4f3b-b23a-24a4859af934: Mid was ours on paper all game and produced a donated lane: 0 kills, 7 deaths, 2 items at 27 minutes, 11,018 hero damage. Alive and ahead in lane with no kill or death credited in the fight at 16.9, lost 0-3; a shove-and-rotate there changes the count. Deaths at 12.1 and 23.1 each came right before an enemy Fangtooth. Lowest grade on the roster.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Six of 19 team kills and 8 wards to Riktor's 16 is a quiet support game; the healing, 16,123, was there.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Won the fight at 22.2 with four kills, but was alive in a winning lane while the fight at 18.5 went 4v5.

6317c922-6a5c-4287-a2a3-24a24aa25bfa.text: Three solo deaths before minute 20 and two fights alive with no kill or death credited outweigh three kills on Aurora.

dd5a8477-4c5d-4f67-a8af-66eea1569e4f.text: Nine deaths and one ward in a jungle Serath ran; their side put 55,064 into structures to our 7,352.

495fb001-0cda-4f3b-b23a-24a4859af934.text: Zero kills, seven deaths and two items from a favored mid lane is a donated lane, not a lost one.

16.9.call: Maco, Boris and Kira went 0-3 into Dekker and Riktor with Greystone and Iggy & Scorch alive and neither credited in it. The call: nobody takes that fight until five are there, or concede it. It cost the outer tower and Fangtooth.

24.4.call: Five alive, and the fight at our outer tower still went 1-4 with Greystone ahead in lane and no kill or death credited in it. Orb Prime then fell at 25.6 with Kira, Maco, Boris and Iggy & Scorch dead from it. The call: Greystone shoves and walks before this starts, or the four back off.

26.3.call: Down on towers and level on items at 14 each, the 5v5 at 26.3 was the only fight left; it went 1-5 and the base followed. The game was decided when Orb Prime fell at 25.6 with four of us dead.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: The build was self-sustain and cooldowns (Hexbound Bracers, Everbloom, Timewarp) with no magic resist against a three-magic comp. The fight at 16.9, lost 0-3 to Dekker and Riktor, is where the core's Enra's Blessing, a shield on an ally the moment they are locked down, earns its slot.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Maco.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Crit and attack speed (Vanquisher, Onixian Quiver, Scattershot) instead of the Solaris, Ashbringer, Imperator core traded away Solaris's empowered heal-back hit and Ashbringer's cooldown refunds for raw hits. The four kills around 22.2 show the damage arrived; the deaths to Serath and Dekker after 24 show the sustain did not.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis pays out on every third straight basic attack on the same hero, which fits Kira's stack-and-shred kit against a frontline of Aurora and Riktor, and trades away the burst a Demiurge item build would give.

6317c922-6a5c-4287-a2a3-24a24aa25bfa.build: On the Overlord, Rapture, Aegis Of Agawar core with Catalytic Drive as the roster's only magic resist against Aurora's 36,529 magic damage; nothing to teach here.
6317c922-6a5c-4287-a2a3-24a24aa25bfa.eternal: Thraex marks whoever Greystone last hit for more damage dealt and less taken, a duelist fit for an offlane that killed Aurora three times, at the cost of Krix's raw health for the teamfight frontline job.

dd5a8477-4c5d-4f67-a8af-66eea1569e4f.build: Tainted Blade in Basilisk's slot gave the team its only anti-heal against Riktor; the gap that showed was magic resist, none of it, while taking 50,669 damage from a three-magic comp.
dd5a8477-4c5d-4f67-a8af-66eea1569e4f.eternal: Vermis rewards three straight basic attacks on one target, which fits a jungler whose whole kit is grabbing one pick and holding it, and gives up the extra health a Krix Boris would bring into a three-magic comp.

495fb001-0cda-4f3b-b23a-24a4859af934.build: Two items in 27 minutes is the whole build read: the missing Entropy never had gold behind it because the lane's 0 kills and 7 deaths fed Wraith, Serath and Dekker instead.
495fb001-0cda-4f3b-b23a-24a4859af934.eternal: Vesh turns every ability hit into a burn over time, the fit for a mage whose kit is layered fire zones, and it only pays when the lane produces hits, which 0 kills and 7 deaths did not.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Riktor. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
ourKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
ourKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
ourKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
ourKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe
